name: Story Maker
description: Choose characters, a place and a kind of story, and a new story is written scene by scene and read aloud by a cast of voices, with choices along the way.

about.concept: Narrative and comprehension. A story the child helped shape is read aloud by different voices for different characters, with the words shown; at the turning points the child chooses what happens next, so listening stays active and the structure of a story (setting, problem, choice, ending) is felt from the inside.
about.progression: Little stories are short, with simple words and one choice. Longer settings bring more scenes, richer vocabulary, several choices with consequences, and questions about what happened and why.
lifeSkills: Making choices and seeing where they lead
